page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-48-lssd is an Arm-based virtual machine configured for memory-intensive and input/output-heavy enterprise computing. Built on the ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 architecture, the instance provides 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 3.0 GHz, featuring 64 KB L1 data cache per core, 2 MB L2 cache per core, and 80 MB of shared L3 cache without multithreading. It delivers an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio with 384 GB of system RAM, alongside 4,020 GB of integrated local NVMe solid-state storage across ten drives. Cryptographic hardware acceleration is enabled via ARM AES instructions, though x86-specific vector extensions are not supported.

Benchmark measurements indicate competitive performance across parallel processing, memory throughput, and data transformation routines. While stress-ng single-core execution registers within the middle 50 percent at 1821.19, multi-core throughput achieves strong results in the top 25 percent at 86659.83. Memory subsystem evaluations highlight strong bandwidth, delivering 334.84 GB/sec for large un-cached reads and 158.43 GB/sec for large writes, complemented by 5935.14 GB/sec in cached small-block reads. Data compression tasks also demonstrate high throughput, including 32.3 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 532.16 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

The bundled 4,020 GB NVMe local storage array provides low-latency disk operations directly attached to the host, avoiding network storage latency overheads. The architectural choice of Arm Neoverse-V2 cores alongside a high memory allocation delivers favorable resource density and energy efficiency per physical core compared to traditional architectures. The instance is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, real-time analytics, caching platforms, ETL data pipelines, and fast-access search indexing.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-48-lssd is an Arm-based instance powered by 48 dedicated ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 cores running at 3.0 GHz without simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 384 GB of memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, along with 4,020 GB of high-speed local NVMe solid-state storage across ten drives. In benchmark evaluations, the server achieves strong multi-threaded compute results alongside exceptional memory bandwidth, measuring 334.84 GB/sec for large read operations and 158.43 GB/sec for large write operations. Compression throughput is equally strong, delivering 532.16 GB/sec during multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. The dense memory configuration and low-latency integrated local NVMe arrays provide efficient resource scaling for memory-bound tasks without network storage latency. This server profile is designed for in-memory databases, large data manipulation pipelines, high-throughput caching tiers, and localized analytics engines.
